name.note: iniBuilds Global Jet manual v1.0 (17 Nov 2026). Catalog name is the sim add-on.

cruiseKt.note: Max cruise. iniBuilds Global Jet manual v1.0 p.9. Real-world 504 KTAS high-speed / 487 KTAS typical.

longRangeCruiseKt.note: FMS default M0.80 at ISA FL360 and above. Manual p.161, 300 KIAS / M0.80 × 573.6 kt, rounded to 459.

averageCruiseKt.note: Manual p.5 M0.85 × 573.6 kt = 487.5, rounded to 488. Factsheet typical cruise is 487 KTAS.

cruiseMach.note: iniBuilds Global Jet manual v1.0 p.5.

climbRateFpm.note: Real-world (EUROCONTROL aircraft performance database, average climb to FL410).

descentRateFpm.note: Real-world (EUROCONTROL aircraft performance database, average descent from FL410).

rangeNm.note: NBAA IFR range. iniBuilds Global Jet manual v1.0 p.9.

ferryRangeNm.note: Not published as a single ferry figure.

fuelBurnLbHr.note: Real-world (Conklin & de Decker, 512 US gal/hr × 6.75 lb/gal).

maxFuelLb.note: Desk figure 45,200 lb. Manual capacity is 45,861 lb (20,802 kg). TCDS usable is 45,050 lb.

fuelDensityLbPerGal.note: Real-world (FAA and EASA type certificate data sheets, 6.75 lb per US gal).

mtowLb.note: Real-world (FAA TCDS T00003NY, maximum takeoff weight 99,500 lb).

mlwLb.note: Real-world (FAA TCDS T00003NY, maximum landing weight 78,600 lb).

mzfwLb.note: Real-world (FAA TCDS T00003NY, maximum zero-fuel weight 58,000 lb).

mrwLb.note: Real-world (FAA TCDS T00003NY, maximum ramp weight 99,750 lb).

oewLb.note: 52,230 lb. Desk book empty weight. The manual does not publish a separate OEW.

maxPax.note: Up to 10 passengers. iniBuilds Global Jet manual v1.0 p.5 and EFB p.34. The add-on has 2 cabin versions. Real-world 12-17 typical, 19 certified.

crewSeats.note: TCDS minimum flight crew is 2. A cabin attendant is not a crew seat.

ceilingFt.note: Real-world (FAA TCDS T00003NY, maximum altitude 51,000 ft. MMO 0.89. VMO 300 KIAS from sea level to 8,000 ft and 340 KIAS from 8,000 to 30,267 ft).

takeoffDistanceFt.note: Real-world (Bombardier factsheet, 6,476 ft at sea level, ISA, maximum takeoff weight).

landingDistanceFt.note: Unfactored landing distance 2,670 ft at sea level, ISA, typical landing weight.

engines.note: Real-world (FAA TCDS T00003NY, BR700-710A2-20, 14,750 lbf takeoff / 14,450 lbf maximum continuous).

mpiIntervalHours.note: Real-world (BR710A2-20 is on-condition; no hard-time MPI).

cziIntervalHours.note: Real-world (BR710A2-20 is on-condition; no hard-time CZI).

remarks.value: MMO 0.89 from 30,267 to 35,000 ft, 0.871 at 47,000 ft, and 0.855 at 51,000 ft. VMO 300 KIAS from sea level to 8,000 ft and 340 KIAS from 8,000 to 30,267 ft. Minimum flight weight 48,200 lb. Usable fuel 45,050 lb plus 172 lb unusable. Length 99 ft 5 in, wingspan 94 ft 0 in, height 25 ft 6 in. Main gear track 13 ft 4 in, wheelbase 42 ft 10 in. No ETOPS type approval; operational EDTO limits depend on operator rules.
remarks.note: Real-world (FAA TCDS T00003NY for the speed schedule, minimum flight weight, and unusable fuel; Bombardier factsheet for height; Global Express FCOM for track and wheelbase). Length, wingspan, and MMO 0.89 are also in the iniBuilds manual p.5 and p.9.
